faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.summary: Answers to the questions people ask most about FacilityPro, plans, payments and support.
faqPage.moreBody: Email {{email}} or call {{phone}}, or book a demo and we'll walk you through it.

items.a: FacilityPro is a maintenance and facilities management system (CMMS). It brings fault requests, work orders, preventive maintenance, assets, vendors and reports into one place, so your team always knows what needs doing and what has been done.

Teams that look after buildings and equipment: commercial and residential property managers, hotels, hospitals and clinics, schools, factories and warehouses. It works for a single building or a portfolio of many sites.
FacilityPro is a brand of ROYAL DESTINY COMPANY LIMITED (Tax ID 0315466813), registered at 75/3 Nguyễn Tử Giản, Phường An Hội Tây, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam.
English and Vietnamese. Each person chooses their own language, and names of locations, assets and categories can be entered in both.

There are five plans: Free ($0, up to 3 staff users), Starter ($29 a month, up to 10), Professional ($49 a month, up to 25), Business ($99 a month, up to 75) and Enterprise (custom pricing). Paying yearly lowers the monthly price to $24, $39 and $79.

Yes. New organisations get 14 days of the Professional plan free, with no credit card needed. When the trial ends you move to the Free plan unless you choose a paid plan. The Free plan itself has no trial and no time limit.

items.q: Do occupants and vendors count as users?
items.a: No. Occupants who report faults and vendors who receive work are free on every plan. Only staff users (admins, managers and technicians) count towards your plan's limit.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
items.a: Yes, at any time from the Billing page. If you cancel, the Free plan's limits apply from then on and nothing is deleted.
Enterprise customers can choose two- or three-year terms. Get in touch and we'll put together a quote.
Admins pay from the Billing page, monthly or yearly, with PayPal or by card. Prices are in US dollars.
Payments are received by ROYAL DESTINY COMPANY LIMITED (Tax ID 0315466813), the company that owns FacilityPro. This is the name you'll see on your PayPal receipt or card statement.
Card and PayPal payments are handled by Stripe and PayPal. FacilityPro never sees or stores your card details.

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: Most teams create their first work order in an afternoon. A full rollout of one site usually takes two to four weeks; see the Rollout playbook for a step-by-step plan.
Yes. Open FacilityPro on your phone and choose "Add to Home Screen"; there's no app store download. Technicians can keep working without a signal, and their updates are sent when they're back online.

items.q: Can tenants report a fault without an account?
items.a: Yes. Anyone can report a fault by scanning an asset's QR code or using your public report link, and signed-in occupants can follow their own requests.
Yes. Messages to your Zalo Official Account arrive in the FacilityPro inbox, where your team can reply and turn them into requests, and people can choose to receive notifications on Zalo.

Each organisation's data is separated at the database level, so no other customer can see it. Connections are encrypted, accounts can use two-factor authentication, and changes are recorded in an audit trail.
Everyone sees only what their role allows. Staff can be limited to their own sites, and occupants only ever see their own requests.
Click ? Help on any page for an explanation of that screen, or open the User guide from the menu. Signed-in staff can also open a support ticket under Help & support.

items.q: How do I contact the team?
items.a: Email sales@facilitypro.tech or call +1 339 800 1703. You can also book a demo from the home page.
